exposure: Fetoscopic laser surgery for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS)
outcome: Adverse neonatal outcome (composite of neonatal mortality or severe neonatal morbidity)
cohort: The study participants were live-born monochorionic twins with twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS).
finding: The risk for adverse neonatal outcome (neonatal mortality and/or severe morbidity) is three-fold higher in monochorionic twins with TTTS not treated with laser surgery compared to those successfully treated with laser.
